mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

setup.title: Enable two-factor authentication
setup.subtitle: Two-factor authentication is mandatory for the platform.

totp.scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, 1Password…).
totp.codeHint: Enter the code shown by the app to confirm.

backup.title: Backup codes
backup.subtitle: Keep them safe: they let you sign in if you lose your device.
backup.warning: Each code works once and will not be shown again. Download or write them down now.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your e-mail address to receive a reset link valid for 30 minutes.
forgot.sent: If an account matches this address, an e-mail has just been sent.

reset.title: New password
reset.subtitle: Choose a new password. All your sessions will be signed out.
reset.done: Password updated. You can sign in.
reset.invalidLink: This link is invalid or has expired. Request a new e-mail.

invite.title: Activate my account
invite.subtitle: You are invited to join {{tenant}}. Choose your password.
invite.name: Full name
invite.done: Account activated. You can sign in.
invite.invalidLink: This invitation link is invalid or has expired.

change.title: Change password
change.subtitle: To continue, choose a new password.

legal.title: Terms and conditions
legal.subtitle: New terms must be accepted before you continue.
legal.confirm: I confirm I have read and accept these documents on behalf of the property.
legal.ownerOnly: Only the account owner can accept these documents. Ask them to sign in.
